messages:
Nora Li: Heads-up — eu-west ingress just threw a bunch of mTLS failures after the key rotation window. Lots of SNI mismatch + cert verify errors in edge logs.
rotator-bot: ALERT: rotator-eu failed to fetch keyversion: NOT_FOUND (key: projects/eu/locations/global/keyRings/certs/cryptoKeys/cert-key/cryptoKeyVersions/7)
Diego Ramos: which rotation run did we trigger? tf-rotation-2026-03-22 or the manual one?
Nora Li: tf-rotation-2026-03-22 triggered autoDestroy on v7 instead of disabling it first. tf apply removed v7 and set v8 as primary. rotator tried to fetch v7 metadata during in-flight rotations.
Sam (oncall): can you paste the proxy error sample and the KMS audit line? need to correlate.
Nora Li: proxy: `tls: remote error: tls: certificate signed by unknown authority for \"svc.eu.redwood\"` then `rotator: getPublicKey failed: NOT_FOUND`
Nora Li: audit log line: `method=CryptoKeyVersions.GetPublicKey principal=serviceAccount:rotator-eu@infra status=NOT_FOUND resource=projects/eu/.../cryptoKeyVersions/7`
Diego Ramos: wait we also merged the RBAC prune this morning that removed roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer from rotator-eu @ PR#4690. That explains GetPublicKey permission issues for new calls (and NOT_FOUND for v7 because it was deleted).
Sam (oncall): two orthogonal issues = deleted keyversion + RBAC removed viewer. Combined effect caused rotator fallback to pick wrong regional key -> SNI mismatch.
Nora Li: mitigation plan: 1) re-add publicKeyViewer role with conditional binding for rotator-eu, 2) restore v7 from key ring replacement snapshot if possible, or roll forward quickly to v8 and ensure rotator trusts v8.
Diego Ramos: I can apply conditional bind: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/eu/locations/global/keyRings/certs/cryptoKeys/cert-key --member=serviceAccount:rotator-eu@infra --role=roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer --condition='expression=resource.name.endsWith(\"/cryptoKeyVersions/8\")'` — but need to ensure v8 is ready.
ops-bot: ACTION: creating incident redwood/ops#2026 \"eu rotator keyversion+rbac mismatch\" and assigning to @Diego @Nora @Sam.
Nora Li: doing quick restart of rotator to pick up v8 once IAM change is live.
rotator-bot: INFO: IAM patch applied (change-id iam-2026-03-22-09)
Nora Li: restarted rotator pods (rotator-eu-0/rotator-eu-1), logs now show `getPublicKey v8 success` and `certificate issued CN=svc.eu.redwood` — early handshakes succeeding :thumbsup:
Sam (oncall): ok temporary mitigation done. Root causes: - Terraform rotation used autoDestroy semantics incorrectly (deleting live key version) - IAM/RBAC pruning removed cloudkms.publicKeyViewer for rotator-eu - rotator fallback logic accepted cross-region key without verifying SAN -> served wrong cert
Diego Ramos: immediate follow-ups: - patch TF rotation to never autoDestroy active key versions; add a manual approval step for destructive key ops - reintroduce RBAC change gating: any role removal that affects cloudkms.* must run an IAM smoke test against rotator canary - tighten rotator fallback: require exact SAN match and origin key id check before serving fallback cert - add metric tag: `rotator_key_version` to tls.handshake_error to speed triage
Nora Li: I've opened infra GH issue infra#7012 "rotation autoDestroy safety + rotator SAN validation" and started a short postmortem with timeline and logs. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/infra/7012
Sam (oncall): longer-term: consider KMS-backed signing where we store public keys in a cached store (read-only) and have rotator validate key existence before switching; or envelope pattern so rotator keeps ephemeral DEKs to avoid per-handshake KMS hits. Also add a pre-apply TF plan check to detect `autoDestroy` on non-staging keyversions.
Diego Ramos: security note: ensure KMS audit logs are forwarded to SIEM with delta alerts for DELETE/DESTROY actions and that RBAC changes trigger a dry-run pipeline to validate service access.
rotator-bot: NOTE: scheduled canary job added for eu region (cert-issue + handshake + OCSP) every 5m (job-id canary-rotator-eu)
Nora Li: monitoring for 1 hour; last check +10m: no NOT_FOUNDs, no handshake SNI mismatches. Will post postmortem when draft is ready.
Sam (oncall): thanks all. We'll add rollback play: if KMS NOT_FOUND > 3 in 5m OR tls.handshake_error{region="eu"} > 10, revert TF to snapshot prior to rotation and restore RBAC snapshot.
